title: Rubio to link ancient Greek values to 'America First' speech in Athens
description: ATHENS, Oct 7 - US Secretary of State Marco Rubio was expected on Wednesday to urge Western nations to embrace the ancient Greek values of \"heroism, honor, and duty\", tying the ideals to President Donald Trump's \"America First\" agenda.
